elaine (eng-security): Heads up — I'm proposing a scope freeze for the upcoming external assessment. Freeze starts today 6pm PT. No RBAC changes or broad infra changes after that unless approved. :lock:
ryan (eng-sre): ack, I'll hold infra churn. quick q: does this include autoscaler tuning?
elaine (eng-security): yes if it touches instance pools or node pools. non-impacting app config ok.
mira (platform): For KMS access the assessors need read-only decrypt via ephemeral session. We can hand them delegated wrap key via kms-proxy. Do we require additional audit hooks?
elaine (eng-security): yes — enable envelope wrapping logs + bind to audit-export stream. Sam, can we set retention 90d for that stream?
sam (oncall): setting retention now. also adding an alert for anomalous key usage. :rotating_light:
audit-bot: Policy change detected: 'kms:Decrypt' grant added to role assessor-readonly at 1761337201
ryan (eng-sre): putting the minimal IAM snippet here for reviewer:
```
{"Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:ReEncrypt*"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234-efgh-5678"}]}
```
elaine (eng-security): thanks. need a short checklist before handoff to vendor: 1) scope freeze confirmed 2) provision ephemeral creds 3) audit stream enabled+retention 4) remediation tracker seeded. I'll post the tracker PR in ~10m.
mira (platform): about remediation tracker — prefer a single sprint ticket with sub-tasks vs many PRs? vendor will want a clear retest criterion.
elaine (eng-security): single tracker with a test-case matrix + expected evidence per finding. Example retest criterion: 'fix deployed to staging + signed audit log showing no decrypts for attacker window'.
sam (oncall): also, we'll run a dry-run of evidence collection Wed 11am PT — plan to invite triage and SRE.
ryan (eng-sre): ack, I'll reserve call bridge.
elaine (eng-security): cool. last ask — no schema changes to our observability pipeline after freeze. if someone needs an exception DM me with justification. :white_check_mark:
